title: A Literate Programming Environment for Human and Machine Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.24644v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper introduces an environment for constructing literate programs in concert with language-aware machine agents. This environment includes a grammar for executable program essays, a parser that treats names as first-class objects, an internal name-graph which relates prose, names and executable artifacts, and a binding mechanism for existing languages and testing toolsets. This supports co-location of code with its most relevant natural language and structured data context, making better use of Large Language Model (LLM) context windows. It also provides LLM coding agents with a toolset more analogous to the symbol-aware search and usage information available in human programmer-facing Integrated Development Environments (IDEs). We describe a working implementation with bindings to three established programming languages, and several example programs.

translated_title: 一种面向人类与机器代理的文学编程环境
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24644v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：本文介绍了一种环境，用于与语言感知的机器代理协同构建文学编程。该环境包括一个可执行程序散文的语法、一个将名称视为一等对象的解析器、一个关联散文、名称和可执行工件的内部名称图，以及一个用于现有语言和测试工具集的绑定机制。这支持代码与其最相关的自然语言和结构化数据上下文共置，从而更好地利用大型语言模型（LLM）的上下文窗口。它还为LLM编码代理提供了一套工具集，更类似于人类程序员面向集成开发环境（IDE）中可用的符号感知搜索和使用信息。我们描述了一个工作实现，该实现绑定到三种成熟编程语言，并提供了几个示例程序。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种文学编程环境，通过名称图和绑定机制增强人机协作，优化LLM上下文利用，并赋予编码代理类似IDE的符号感知能力。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a literate programming environment with a name-graph and binding mechanism that enhances human-machine collaboration, optimizes LLM context usage, and gives coding agents IDE-like symbol-aware capabilities.
